MEDIA TECHNOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: MEDIA TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. When learning Photography, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Photography.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Photography.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Photography.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Photography.

3. When learning Introduction to Media Technology 1.2 Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Prod, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Media Technology 1.2 Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Prod.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Media Technology 1.2 Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Prod.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Media Technology 1.2 Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Prod.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Media Technology 1.2 Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Prod.

4. When learning Post- production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Post- production.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Post- production.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Post- production.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Post- production.

5. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Keyboard
   C. Speaker
   D. Monitor

6. When learning Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography 2.2 Digital Video Productio, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography 2.2 Digital Video Productio.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography 2.2 Digital Video Productio.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography 2.2 Digital Video Productio.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography 2.2 Digital Video Productio.

7. When learning Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photo, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photo.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photo.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photo.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photo.

8. When learning Introduction to Media Technology, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Media Technology.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Media Technology.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Media Technology.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Media Technology.

9. When learning Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P.

10. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. Input Cable Tester

11. When learning Audio Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Audio Production.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Audio Production.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Audio Production.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Audio Production.

12. When learning Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Production.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Production.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Production.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Production.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Media Technology and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photo and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Pre - Production and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Production and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

4. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Post- production.

6. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography 2.2 Digital Video Productio.

7. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photo.

9. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P.

12. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Production.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Introduction to Media Technology; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Production; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
